hero.title: About UniLink
hero.tagline: We believe that choosing a university is a decision that changes the future
hero.intro: Every year, thousands of students and parents face a real challenge searching for the right university among dozens of universities and study programs, with scattered information, unclear comparisons, and complicated application procedures.
hero.bridge: That is where the idea of UniLink came from
hero.body: We created UniLink to be the digital platform that connects students with universities in a smart and transparent way, and helps every student make the right decision based on their interests, means, and goals, not just on advertising or incomplete information.
hero.imageAlt: A family exploring universities together on a laptop

vision.title: Our vision
vision.body: To become the leading digital platform in Egypt that connects students with higher education institutions, and to contribute to the digital transformation of the university education sector by providing a unified, easy, and trusted experience for everyone involved.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: Empowering students to reach the right information, compare universities easily, and choose their future with confidence, while providing digital solutions that help universities reach the students best suited to their academic programs.

students.title: For students
students.imageAlt: A student browsing universities on UniLink
items: Explore Egyptian universities in one place.
Compare universities and study programs easily.
Search by major, location, tuition fees, and study system.
Access accurate and up to date information about universities.
Follow application dates and important news.
Apply to participating universities through a simplified digital experience.

universities.title: For universities
items: Reach students who are already interested in their programs.
Improve the quality of communication with applicants.
Benefit from data and analytics to understand student interests and market trends.
Strengthen digital transformation across admissions and marketing.

why.title: Why UniLink?
why.body1: Because we do not only list universities. We build an experience that helps students make a life defining decision with confidence, and gives universities a more efficient channel to reach the right students.
why.body2: We rely on simplicity, transparency, accurate information, and continuous development to deliver a digital education experience that matches the ambitions of a new generation.

items.title: Transparency
items.body: We provide clear and accurate information that helps you make the right decision.

items.title: Innovation
items.body: We use technology to simplify the university search and application journey.

items.title: Reliability
items.body: We work for our data and services to be a source that students and universities can rely on.

items.title: User focus
items.body: We design every feature on the platform starting from the needs of the student and the university.

items.label: Supporting digital transformation in higher education
